'''Papa Jawa Rock of Numbers''' is a [[Dark]] deck by Papa Jawa, published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds23.htm Rock of Numbers], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040214162313/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds23.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' Papa Jawa
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]] (from the card pool)
* '''Published:''' [[Trandosite]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
